compute.source: Fitted to the device + host compute buffers that llama.cpp b11552 fit-params reports for Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B at 262,144 and 1,048,576 tokens (2026-10-12). Other sizes are not checked.

runtime_overhead.source: Peak MemTotal - MemAvailable minus the idle baseline on a DGX Spark, Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B Q8_0 with 4 slots at 262,144 and 1,048,576 tokens (2026-10-12).

moe_offload.source: Added to both sides of the split between GPU and system RAM when experts run on the CPU (--cpu-moe), because the expert share in families.json counts parameters, not bytes, and quantisation is not uniform across tensors. Not measured.

cpu_overhead.source: Replaces runtime_overhead.base_mib on CPU-only machines, which have no GPU driver context. Not measured.
